title: Enticingly Caramelized Korean Garlic Jjigae
description: A vegan-friendly Korean stew featuring garlic cloves, perfectly caramelized and simmered in a copper-mug.
instructions: In a copper-mug, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add 12 cloves of minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and fragrant.
Add 2 tablespoons of gochujang, 1 teaspoon of Korean chili flakes, 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon of sugar.
Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until the sauce is smooth and fragrant.
Add 1 cup of sliced mushrooms, 2 medium sliced carrots, and 1 medium sliced zucchini.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Add 1 cup of water, then bring to a simmer.
Cook for 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and 1/4 cup of chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
